 When is Amazon's Black Friday sale?
 Amazon has announced that its Black Friday sale will begin on November 19th and run through Cyber Monday on November 30th. That gives you 12 full days to explore some of the best deals of the year. 
 What deals should I expect during Amazon's Black Friday sale?
 Black Friday generally focuses on quantity rather than quality, so even if Amazon's discounts don't break records, you'll have plenty of great offers to choose from. Expect solid discounts on Samsung's Galaxy S26 series and the Google Pixel 11 lineup, in addition to impressive price drops on the latest foldable phones, such as the Galaxy Z Fold 8 . Tablets and smartwatches are sure to get some good discounts, as well, so keep your eyes peeled for our coverage of the latest offers.
